# cellNexusWorkshop

![cellNexus logo](reference/figures/cellnexus_logo.png)![sccomp
logo](reference/figures/sccomp_logo.png)

Hands-on BiocAsia workshop. From a curated Human Cell Atlas query to
donor-level composition and expression analysis, in R.

This is the page to follow during the session. Read this page, then the
articles in order. The session is open to all levels of R experience.
Each article shows the commands to run.

## Instructor names and contact information

- Mengyuan Shen <shen.m@wehi.edu.au>
- Yingnan Gao <yingnan.gao@adelaide.edu.au>
- Stefano Mangiola <stefano.mangiola@adelaide.edu.au>

## Syllabus

Follow these articles in one R session.

- [Query the
  atlas](https://myushen.github.io/cellNexusWorkshop/articles/query_the_atlas.md)
- [Explore and
  visualise](https://myushen.github.io/cellNexusWorkshop/articles/explore_and_visualise.md)
- [Compositional
  analysis](https://myushen.github.io/cellNexusWorkshop/articles/compositional_analysis.md)
- [Gene
  expression](https://myushen.github.io/cellNexusWorkshop/articles/gene_expression.md)
- [Solutions](https://myushen.github.io/cellNexusWorkshop/articles/solutions.md)

## Package installation

The commands below are for preparing a machine. The workshop targets R
4.5 or later. `cellNexus` is installed from GitHub. Install CmdStan
before the first `sccomp` fit so the session does not stop on a
compiler.

\
[`install.packages`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html)`(``"BiocManager"``)`\
[`install.packages`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html)`(``"remotes"``)`\
[`Sys.setenv`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/Sys.setenv.html)`(``"R_REMOTES_NO_ERRORS_FROM_WARNINGS"`` ``=`` ``"true"``)`\
\
[`install.packages`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html)`(`\
`  ``"cmdstanr"``,`\
`  repos ``=`` `[`c`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)`(``"https://mc-stan.org/r-packages/"``, `[`getOption`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/options.html)`(``"repos"``)``)`\
`)`\
`cmdstanr``::``check_cmdstan_toolchain``(``fix ``=`` ``TRUE``)`\
`cmdstanr``::``install_cmdstan``(``)`\
\
`BiocManager``::`[`install`](https://bioconductor.github.io/BiocManager/reference/install.html)`(`[`c`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/c.html)`(`\
`  ``"dplyr"``, ``"tidyr"``, ``"ggplot2"``, ``"patchwork"``, ``"stringr"``, ``"Matrix"``,`\
`  ``"SummarizedExperiment"``, ``"SingleCellExperiment"``,`\
`  ``"scater"``, ``"scran"``, ``"scuttle"``, ``"scrapper"``, ``"bluster"``, ``"harmony"``,`\
`  ``"DESeq2"``, ``"org.Hs.eg.db"``, ``"AnnotationDbi"``, ``"singscore"``,`\
`  ``"tidySingleCellExperiment"``, ``"tidySummarizedExperiment"``,`\
`  ``"tidybulk"``, ``"tidyseurat"``, ``"tidyomics"``, ``"Seurat"``,`\
`  ``"dbplyr"``, ``"duckdb"`\
`)``)`\
\
`remotes``::`[`install_github`](https://remotes.r-lib.org/reference/install_github.html)`(``"MangiolaLaboratory/cellNexus"``)`\
`remotes``::`[`install_github`](https://remotes.r-lib.org/reference/install_github.html)`(``"MangiolaLaboratory/sccomp"``)`\
`remotes``::`[`install_github`](https://remotes.r-lib.org/reference/install_github.html)`(``"myushen/cellNexusWorkshop"``)`

From a clone of this repository, install the workshop package with
`remotes::install_local(".", dependencies = FALSE)` after the packages
above.

A Docker image that runs the same install is `Dockerfile`, based on
`bioconductor/bioconductor_docker:devel`.

Open the reusable script after installation:

\
[`file.edit`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/file.edit.html)`(`[`system.file`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/system.file.html)`(`\
`  ``"scripts"``, ``"workshop_respiratory_ageing.R"``,`\
`  package ``=`` ``"cellNexusWorkshop"`\
`)``)`

## Workshop description

In this session you will use cellNexus to query and download a curated
subset of atlas data by tissue, cell type, or disease status, then
explore and visualise the data with the tidyomics packages. You will
then run a gene-expression analysis and use sccomp for a compositional
analysis. By the end of the session you will have an R script that takes
you from the Human Cell Atlas to these analyses.

### Pre-requisites

- No prior R experience is required. The articles show each command.
- An R 4.5 session with the packages above, and CmdStan installed

### Workshop participation

The workshop format is a 90 minute session consisting of hands-on demos,
exercises and questions. Run the article code in order, in one R
session. Each exercise has a solution hidden underneath it. The
[Solutions](https://myushen.github.io/cellNexusWorkshop/articles/solutions.md)
page collects the same answers.

The website shows the code. Run it in R to see your own results. The
figures already on the site are examples from a larger download (12,000
cells, and a slower `sccomp` fit). During the session the download is
capped at 4,000 cells and `sccomp` uses Pathfinder, which finishes
sooner, so your figures can look a little different. To match the
example figures, set `CELLNEXUS_WORKSHOP_MAX_CELLS=12000` and
`CELLNEXUS_WORKSHOP_INFERENCE=hmc` before you start.

### *R* / *Bioconductor* packages used

- [cellNexus](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.04.14.718336v3)
- [sccomp](https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.2203828120)
- tidySingleCellExperiment, tidySummarizedExperiment, tidybulk,
  tidyseurat
- scater, scran, scrapper, bluster, harmony
- DESeq2, org.Hs.eg.db, singscore

### Workshop goals and objectives

Participants leave with a script that defines a cohort from cellNexus
metadata, downloads the matching counts, and fits two donor-level
models: cell-type composition, and gene expression within one epithelial
cluster.

#### Learning goals

- Query curated atlas metadata and turn a filter into a
  SingleCellExperiment or a Seurat object
- Keep the donor as the replicate for both composition and expression
- Detect composition changes with sccomp
- Test expression on sample-by-cluster pseudobulk with tidybulk

#### What you will learn

- How to filter cellNexus metadata by cell type, by a pinned set of
  studies, and by Census disease and tissue labels
- How tidySingleCellExperiment connects a SingleCellExperiment to dplyr
  and ggplot2
- A respiratory ageing case study: immune composition across nine
  studies, then epithelial differential expression

#### What you will not learn

- The molecular technology of single-cell sequencing
- How to train a cell-type classifier
- The Python interface

## References

- Shen et al. (2026). cellNexus: quality control, annotation,
  aggregation and analytical layers for the Human Cell Atlas data.
  *bioRxiv*.
  <https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.04.14.718336v3>
- Mangiola et al. (2023). sccomp: robust differential composition and
  variability analysis for single-cell data. *Proceedings of the
  National Academy of Sciences*.
  <https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.2203828120>
- Squair et al. (2021). Confronting false discoveries in single-cell
  differential expression. *Nature Communications* 12:5692.
  <https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-021-25960-2>
- Lun, McCarthy, and Marioni (2016). A step-by-step workflow for
  low-level analysis of single-cell RNA-seq data with Bioconductor.
  *F1000Research* 5:2122.
  <https://doi.org/10.12688/f1000research.9501.2>
- Korsunsky et al. (2019). Fast, sensitive and accurate integration of
  single-cell data with Harmony. *Nature Methods* 16:1289–1296.
  <https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-019-0619-0>
- Love, Huber, and Anders (2014). Moderated estimation of fold change
  and dispersion for RNA-seq data with DESeq2. *Genome Biology* 15:550.

  *BMC Bioinformatics* 19:404.
  <https://doi.org/10.1186/s12859-018-2435-4>

## Publish this site

The articles are the package vignettes. GitHub Actions
(`.github/workflows/rworkflows.yml`) builds the pkgdown site and deploys
the `gh-pages` branch. In the repository settings, set GitHub Pages to
that branch. The address is the `url` field in `_pkgdown.yml`. Change
that URL, and the GitHub links, if the repository is published under a
different account.

Build the site locally with
[`pkgdown::build_site()`](https://pkgdown.r-lib.org/reference/build_site.html).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`annotate_cell_nexus()`](https://myushen.github.io/cellNexusWorkshop/reference/annotate_cell_nexus.md)
  : Add age variables and drop sparse samples from a cellNexus query.
- [`epithelial_cell_types()`](https://myushen.github.io/cellNexusWorkshop/reference/epithelial_cell_types.md)
  : Epithelial labels used for the expression analysis.
- [`immune_cell_types()`](https://myushen.github.io/cellNexusWorkshop/reference/immune_cell_types.md)
  : Immune labels used as the composition denominator.
- [`respiratory_dataset_ids()`](https://myushen.github.io/cellNexusWorkshop/reference/respiratory_dataset_ids.md)
  : Dataset identifiers for the respiratory reference cohort.
- [`select_de_cluster()`](https://myushen.github.io/cellNexusWorkshop/reference/select_de_cluster.md)
  : Choose the epithelial cluster for the donor-level age model.
